deadline.quote: Application deadline is 15th of June for non EU applicants and 1st of August for applicants from EU.
deadline.notes: '15th of June for non EU applicants', no year printed; the portal sheet shows only the 'Fall semester 2026/27' intake. A deadline without a year is not dated (as KIT in dev4).

tuition.quote: Bachelor's degree programmes in Engineering/IT/Technologies 4950 EUR
tuition.notes: Under 'The following tuition fees for one year (2026-2027 academic year) are set for non-EU students'. The portal sheet: '€4,950 per year' (no year). Plus 200 EUR registration fee and 100 EUR application fee. 2027/28 not published.

value.name: VILNIUS TECH tuition-free and partial scholarships for Bachelor's studies

scholarship_exists.quote: VILNIUS TECH offers both tuition-free scholarships and partial scholarships (50% and 25% of the tuition fee).
scholarship_exists.notes: Academic Year 2026-2027 call, deadline 20 April 2026 (2026 cycle). Competitive: academic results (min 80% tuition-free / 70% partial), motivation letter, 2 references, English B2, recorded interview. Tuition only; awarded for four years without academic debts.
